facts.fact: Atarazanas is an eighteenth-century colonial structure behind Santiago Bastion.
facts.excerpt: built in the 18th century behind the Santiago Bastion

facts.fact: It was built with coral stone.
Its former uses included naval shipyard and royal warehouse.
facts.excerpt: served as a naval shipyard and royal Spanish warehouse

facts.fact: Its present cultural uses include exhibitions, workshops and traditional events.
facts.excerpt: hosting art exhibitions, workshops, and traditional events
